'''Harald Bergström''' (1 April 1908 – 23 May 2001) was  a Swedish mathematician, specializing in probability theory.<ref>{{cite journal|url=http://projecteuclid.org/DPubS/Repository/1.0/Disseminate?view=body&id=pdf_1&handle=euclid.ss/1029963262|title=A conversation with Harald Bergström|author=Lennart Råde|journal=Stat. Sci.|volume=12|issue=1|pages=53–60|year=1997|doi=10.1214/ss/1029963262|doi-access=free}}</ref>

==Education and career==
Harald Bergström studied mathematics, physics and chemistry at the [[Uppsala University]] and received in 1931 his master's degree. From 1932 to 1934 he taught at secondary schools and then worked as a research assistant at the [[Uppsala University]]. There he received his Ph.D. in 1938<ref name=":0">{{MathGenealogy|id=34962}}</ref> and taught until 1945.

In 1946 he moved to [[Chalmers University of Technology]] in Göteborg, where in 1949 he was appointed a professor of applied mathematics. In 1960 he was also appointed a professor for numerical analysis and mathematical statistics. In 1974 he retired as professor emeritus.

At the University of Uppsala, Harald Bergström did research mainly on [[algebraic number fields]] and related topics. After his move to Chalmers University of Technology, he focused on probability theory and statistics. He was supervisor to [[Peter Jagers]].<ref name=":0" /> He made important contributions to [[central limit theorem]]s and the theory of [[stable distribution|alpha stable distributions]].  The widely used [[Cauchy–Schwarz_inequality#Sedrakyan's_lemma_-_Positive_real_numbers|Bergström's inequality]] is named, amongst others, after him.

He was an [[invited speaker at the International Congress of Mathematicians]] in 1936 at Oslo and in 1950 at Cambridge, Massachusetts. In 1973 Chalmers University of Technology published a book of essays in honour of his sixty-fifth birthday.<ref>[[Peter Jagers]], Lennart Råde (eds.): ''Mathematics and statistics. Essays in honour of Harald Bergström''. On the occasion of the 65th birthday of Harald Bergström. Chalmers Institute of Technology, Göteborg, 1973</ref>

==Selected publications==
===Books===
* ''Limit Theorems for Convolutions.'' Almqvist och Wicksell, Stockholm, und Wiley, New York 1963.
* [https://books.google.com/books/about/Weak_Convergence_of_Measures.html?id=f4TiBQAAQBAJ ''Weak Convergence of Measures.''] Academic Press, New York 1982.

===Articles===
* ''Zur Theorie der biquadratischen Zahlkörper. Die Arithmetik auf klassenkörpertheoretischer Grundlage.'' Dissertation. In: ''Nova Acta Regiae Societatis Scientiarum Upsaliensis.'' Series 4, Volume 10, No. 8. Almqvist & Wiksell, Uppsala 1937.
* ''Über die Methode von Woronoj zur Berechnung einer Basis eines kubischen Zahlkörpers.'' In: ''Arkiv för matematik, astronomi och fysik.'' Volume 25B, No. 26. Almqvist & Wiksell, Stockholm 1937.
* ''Vereinfachter Beweis des Hauptidealsatzes der Klassenkörpertheorie.'' In: ''Arkiv för matematik, astronomi och fysik.'' Volume 29B, No. 6. Almqvist & Wiksell, Stockholm 1943.
* ''Struktur der Erweiterungen abelscher Gruppen.'' In: ''Arkiv för matematik, astronomi och fysik.'' Volume 30, No. 4. Almqvist & Wiksell, Stockholm 1944.
* ''On the central limit theorem.'' Scandinavian Actuarial Journal Vol. 27, 1944. {{doi|10.1080/03461238.1944.10404925}}
* ''On the central limit theorem in the space R<sub>k</sub>, k > 1'' Scandinavian Actuarial Journal Vol. 28, 1945, pp.&nbsp;106–127. {{doi|10.1080/03461238.1945.10404921}}
* ''On the central limit theorem in the case of not equally distributed random variables.'' Scandinavian Actuarial Journal Vol. 32, 1949, pp.&nbsp;37–62. {{doi|10.1080/03461238.1949.10419757}}
* ''On some Expansions of stable distribution functions.'' In: ''Arkiv för matematik.'' Vol. 2, No. 18. Almqvist & Wiksell, Stockholm 1952, pp.&nbsp;375–378.
* ''Eine Theorie der stabilen Verteilungsfunktionen.'' In: ''Archiv der Mathematik.'' Volume 2, 1953, pp.&nbsp;380–391.
* ''On the limit theorem for convolutions of distribution functions.'' In: ''Journal für die Reine und Angewandte Mathematik.''<br/>[https://eudml.org/doc/150350 Part 1]: 1957 Vol. 198, pp.&nbsp;121–142.<br />[http://eudml.org/doc/150353 Part 2]: 1958 Vol. 199, pp.&nbsp;1–22.
* {{cite journal|title=A comparison method for distribution functions of sums of independent and dependent random variables|journal=Theory of Probability & Its Applications|volume=15|issue=3|year=1970|pages=430–457|doi=10.1137/1115048|last1=Bergström|first1=H.}}
